dev.emem/observed_latency.note: measured here over recent calls, not a budget

description:
State what you want in one typed object and get the answer. You do not choose a primitive. `type` selects the intent AND the other fields that the tool reads. Send only the fields in its row. The plan runs in the same call: you get results, not a list of calls.

type | needs | optional | answers
where_is | description | | cell64 for a named place
what_is_here | cell OR place | description | what is attested at a location
is_like | a, b | | cosine similarity of two cells
did_change | cell, band, window | | delta for one band over [start,end] tslots
find_like | key | k, filter | nearest cells by embedding
confirm | claim, cell | | verdict and the signed facts behind it
ask | description | place/cell/lat+lng | free-text question, packaged answer
area_over_time | geometry, bbox OR areas; start_date, end_date | index, max_scenes | index of an area for each overpass, with spread and anomaly

An unknown or missing `type` returns a `needs_intent_type` envelope with the valid values. It is not a hard error.

When to use: Call this when the question matches one of the eight rows and you prefer to state the goal. Otherwise call the primitive. A band at a cell is emem_recall. A region is emem_recall_polygon. A free-text question about a place is emem_ask (type:"ask" sends it there). `window` takes tslots, not dates: get them from emem_trajectory. `areas` puts up to 6 areas on one chart. You can call a tool that this text names but your list does not show, by name, through tools/call.

Example arguments: {"type":"did_change","cell":"defi.zb64a.cAzU.zfa27","band":"indices.ndvi","window":[20245,20620]}

inputSchema.description: A tagged union on `type`; fields of other intents are ignored.

a.description: is_like only: cell64 of the first place in the pair.

areas.description: area_over_time: up to 6 {id,geometry|bbox} on one chart

b.description: is_like only: cell64 of the second place. The answer is a cosine similarity in [-1,1] over the two cells' embeddings.

band.description: did_change only: which band to test, e.g. "indices.ndvi". One band per call; the answer is a delta over `window`, not a whole-cell diff.

cell.description: cell64 address, e.g. "defi.zb64a.cAzU.zfa27". Required by did_change and confirm. Optional for what_is_here and ask: supply it to skip geocoding, omit it and give `place` instead.

claim.description: confirm only: the claim to test at `cell`, e.g. {"band":"indices.ndvi","op":"gt","value":0.4}. The answer is a verdict plus the signed facts it rests on.

agg.description: How a `window` reduces: any/all quantify over the facts in it; mean/min/max compare the reduced value against `value`.

op.description: Comparison. These ten spellings and no others: `greater_than`, `>` and `gte` are all rejected. in/ni take an array `value` (member / not member). exists and absent ask only whether the band is attested here.

tslot.description: Test at one tslot. Omit for the latest. Mutually exclusive with `window`.

value.description: Right-hand side. A number for the ordering ops, an array for in/ni. REQUIRED by the parser even for exists/absent, which then ignore it — omitting it fails the whole intent with `missing field value`.

window.description: Test across [start, end] tslots instead of one. Requires `agg` to say how the values across the window collapse to a verdict.

description.description: where_is: the place to resolve, e.g. "Mount Everest". ask: the user's question, forwarded verbatim. what_is_here: optional free text used as the question and, if `place` is absent, as the place. Ignored by the other intents.

filter.description: find_like only: optional claim constraining which cells may be returned. Same object as `claim` below, same ops, same required fields.

agg.description: How a `window` reduces to a single verdict.

band.description: Band the neighbour must satisfy, e.g. "indices.ndvi".

tslot.description: Test at one tslot. Mutually exclusive with `window`.

value.description: Right-hand side. Required by the parser even for exists/absent, which ignore it.

window.description: Test across [start, end] tslots instead of one. Requires `agg`.

k.description: find_like only: how many neighbours to return.

key.description: find_like only: cell64 to search from, ranked by embedding cosine.

lat.description: ask only: latitude, paired with `lng`, when you want to pin the location by coordinate rather than by name or cell64.

place.description: Free-text place name for what_is_here and ask when you have a name but no cell64, e.g. "Ashok Nagar, Ranchi". The responder geocodes it. Ignored when `cell` is present.

type.description: Which intent; the table in the description gives each row's fields.

window.description: did_change only: exactly two tslots, [start, end], band-tempo-relative integers from the emem epoch (NOT unix seconds or a date string). Get valid tslots for a cell from emem_trajectory.

name: emem_intent
title: Intent-routed planner
